scenarios.name: Scenario A — 5 delivery + 5 return
scenarios.interpretation: This scenario supports a distance-to-cycle-time curve rather than a single fixed cycle time.

scenarios.name: Scenario B — 6 delivery + 8 return
scenarios.interpretation: The calculated output confirms that a simple 3600 / cycle_time model is insufficient because mission composition changes effective productivity.

scenarios.name: Scenario C — 5 delivery + 5 return
scenarios.interpretation: The 245.21 s case is a long-distance or combined motion case that must be treated as an edge condition in the cycle model.

scenarios.name: Scenario D — 4 delivery + 3 return
scenarios.interpretation: This scenario reinforces that route pattern and mission mix matter as much as the nominal transport speed.

recommended_model_structure.modeling_note: This evidence should be treated as a cycle knowledge model, not as a single scalar cycle-time table.
